summary: This April 2024 Iran strategy lecture is already public Strategy evidence for the rule that dominance is not victory; its remaining pressure is forecast discipline around Iran ground invasion timing, Trump-war causation, regional-power emergence, and slow American imperial decline.

concept_extensions.proposed_addition: Already public: keep this source as the April 2024 origin layer for the Iran-war material-test rule that technology, intelligence, aircraft carriers, and precision strikes establish dominance but do not settle control of the war. The dark-forest, drone-cost, and Millennium Challenge passages show that the weaker side can win by changing terrain, exchange ratios, and rules of engagement.
concept_extensions.boundary_note: Strategy owns dominance-versus-control and the material audit of whether a war form can be implemented. Chokepoint owns access-control surfaces; Prediction owns dated forecast scoring.

concept_extensions.proposed_addition: Hold the carrier, drone-swarm, suicide-boat, and cost-ratio passages as early support for asymmetric chokepoint pressure: expensive naval platforms and defensive systems can become the wrong objects to have when the weaker side turns access and defense into a bad exchange ratio.
concept_extensions.boundary_note: Chokepoint receives this only where the mechanism is access denial, naval exposure, and exchange-ratio pressure. Strategy remains the parent for the broader dominance/control diagnostic.

concept_extensions.proposed_addition: Queue the dated forecast family rather than promote it: Jiang says on 2024-04-24 that Iran and Israel are committed to war, a ground invasion of Iran may arrive in roughly two years, Trump would most likely initiate a war if elected, and American trouble over the next decade comes from overextension, debt, and civil unrest.
concept_extensions.boundary_note: Prediction owns source date, horizon, caveat, and later comparison. This should not reopen the domestic ground-invasion/draft/emergency-powers review unless later source pressure ties those branches directly.

concept_extensions.proposed_addition: Use the regional-powers close as early source support for imperial retrenchment: if the American cap weakens, Germany, Israel, and Japan become regional powers inside a parallel or multipolar world rather than one peer competitor replacing the United States immediately.
concept_extensions.boundary_note: Imperial Retrenchment owns the weakening American cap and regional successor burden. Nation or Prediction may receive country-specific resurgence only after comparison with later Germany/Japan/Israel forecast sources.

concept_extensions.proposed_addition: Hold the Iran strategy matrix as method evidence: before invasion, every Iranian move must satisfy multiple payoffs at once, uniting the population, proving credibility to Russia and China, keeping Gaza in global attention, and weakening the enemy coalition.
concept_extensions.boundary_note: Game Theory gets the multi-payoff actor model only as method support. Strategy owns whether the matrix passes the material war test; Prediction owns whether the forecast sequence actually unfolds.

chronology_notes.concept: When War Becomes A Story Instead Of A Material Test
chronology_notes.note: On 2024-04-24 Jiang gives an early public formulation of the Iran-war material test: military dominance can coexist with strategic failure when the weaker side controls terrain, costs, timing, public opinion, and rules of engagement.

The ground-invasion and Trump-war claims are dated to 2024-04-24 and carry Jiang's own caveat that the scenario is theory and prediction, not certainty. Keep the two-year horizon, possible trigger problem, and later comparison path visible.

The close describes American decline as slow and regionalizing: even a lost Iran war would not instantly create a peer competitor, but would move the world toward regional blocks led by Germany, Japan, and Israel under a weakened American cap.

canon_candidates.candidate: On 2024-04-24 Jiang predicts or hypothesizes that Iran and Israel are committed to war and that a ground invasion of Iran could occur in roughly two years, while warning that the scenario is conjectural.
canon_candidates.promotion_condition: Compare with later July 2024, 2025, and March-April 2026 Iran/Hormuz forecast-family records; split ground invasion, air or infrastructure attack, Hormuz access, and no-exit escalation before ledger promotion.

canon_candidates.candidate: Jiang says if Trump wins the presidency, Trump is most likely to initiate war against Iran, possibly around the same two-year horizon.
canon_candidates.promotion_condition: Compare with later Trump/Iran, domestic spectacle, Caesar, and escalation-ladder records; do not merge this with domestic draft or emergency-powers claims unless later source pressure supplies the connection.

canon_candidates.candidate: Jiang says the American empire is heading into trouble over the next ten years because overextension, debt, and civil unrest are all active, but decline may take decades or centuries and produce regional blocks rather than a single replacement hegemon.
canon_candidates.promotion_condition: Compare with later imperial retrenchment, debt, and regional-power forecasts; keep the ten-year trouble claim separate from the longer decline timeline.
